**Anti-armor** is a first star legendary mod in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Milepost Zero* update.

## Effects[]

+50% armor penetration

## Locations[]

- Mod boxes have a 1.5% chance to be received from scrapping an Anti-armor legendary item.
- Can be crafted at a tinker's workbench once learned.
 - Crafting has a 1% chance to be unlocked from scrapping an Anti-armor legendary item.
- Can be applied to gear at a weapons workbench.
